decisions.safety_protocol: Temporary hold on ADC stocking of both anticoagulant concentrations; pharmacy supplies only pharmacy-prepared 1 mg/mL syringes during the hold period.
decisions.dispensing_concentration: Standardize to single pharmacy-prepared 1 mg/mL concentration only; remove both 1 mg/mL and 2 mg/mL from automated dispensing cabinets.
decisions.laboratory_monitoring: Proceed with aPTT monitoring every six hours as the approved replacement protocol until anti-Xa analyzer calibration is complete on Friday at 17:00. Ensure clear communication of aPTT therapeutic range and interpretation differences to treating clinicians.
decisions.nurse_authorization: Limit protocol use tonight to units with sufficient numbers of nurses who have already completed the competency module. Defer expansion to other units until the 18 untrained nurses complete the module. Charge-nurse sign-off for all 18 nurses tonight is not feasible.
decisions.electronic_alert: Deploy the EMR concentration-selection alert at 16:00 today as an additional ordering-stage safeguard, complementary to the single-concentration dispensing approach.

commitments.detail: Pharmacy to remove both concentrations from ADCs and supply only pharmacy-prepared 1 mg/mL syringes for the duration of the temporary hold.
Deploy the EMR concentration-selection alert at 16:00 today, before any orders are placed for the night shift.
Communicate aPTT monitoring plan, including therapeutic range and interpretation differences from anti-Xa, to all treating clinicians before the night shift begins.
Prioritize completion of the anticoagulant administration module for the 18 nurses who have not yet completed it, to enable protocol expansion to additional units for the next shift cycle.
Identify units with sufficient competency-completed nurses to support the protocol tonight and restrict protocol use to those units until competency gaps are closed.
